typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DATA as string,
		ASSIGNMENT as string,
		ROW_NUM as integer,
		FILE_TYPE as string,
		FILENAMEVARIABLE as string,
		SUBMISSION_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::LOAD_INTO_TABLE_QUERY',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of FILENAMEVARIABLE} = toString(FILENAMEVARIABLE)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive({Copy of FILENAMEVARIABLE} = {Copy of FILENAMEVARIABLE}) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DATA as string,
		ROW_NUM as string,
		Submission_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MCP_CODE as string,
		FILE_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DATA,
		ROW_NUM,
		Submission_Date = SUBMISSION_DATE,
		MCP_CODE = {Copy of FILENAMEVARIABLE},
		FILE_TYPE)) ~> OLEDBDestination
